FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked
FAQ.DESCRIPTION: Find answers about celestial alignments, product sourcing, ritual safety, and shipping logistics.

CHOOSE_COLLECTION.QUESTION: How do I choose the correct collection for my intention?
CHOOSE_COLLECTION.ANSWER: We recommend taking our interactive Ritual Quiz on the home page. Alternatively, you can browse by "Intention" in the shop menu. If you seek release and clean spaces, choose Cleansing. If you seek career growth or business progress, choose Finance.

MOON_PHASES.QUESTION: What is the significance of the Moon Phases in your pouring cycle?
MOON_PHASES.ANSWER: We align our crafting process with celestial cycles. Products intended for release, clearing, and boundary-protection are poured during the Waning Moon. Products designed for growth, wealth attraction, and love are poured during the Waxing Moon or Full Moon. This anchors the physical creation process in alignment with cosmic tides.

CRYSTAL_CHIPS.QUESTION: Are the crystal chips in the candles safe to burn?
CRYSTAL_CHIPS.ANSWER: Yes. The crystal points (clear quartz, rose quartz, pyrite) embedded in our soy candles are naturally heat-resistant. As the wax pools, the crystals sinks down, charging the hot wax. Once the candle is fully burned, you can carefully wash the crystals in warm water and keep them as talismanic tokens.

SHELF_LIFE.QUESTION: What is the shelf life of your anointing oils?
SHELF_LIFE.ANSWER: Since we use pure cold-pressed carrier oils and organic botanical essential oils without synthetic stabilizers, our elixirs remain at maximum potency for 12 to 18 months. Store them in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.

ENERGETIC_FREQUENCY.QUESTION: How is the energetic frequency of the products protected during transit?
ENERGETIC_FREQUENCY.ANSWER: Every order is packed in a heavy-duty, double-walled black presentation box lined with velvet shielding material and sealed with hot wax. We also place a small clear quartz chip inside every package to stabilize the vibration during long-distance shipping.

INTERNATIONAL_SHIPPING.QUESTION: Do you offer international shipping and standard delivery times?
INTERNATIONAL_SHIPPING.ANSWER: We ship worldwide from our atelier. Domestic orders are processed in 2 business days and arrive in 3-5 days. International orders take 7-14 business days. Signature is required for all talismans and crystal bottles to ensure safe delivery.

CONTACT.TITLE: Have an Unlisted Inquiry?
CONTACT.DESCRIPTION: Our ritual consulting team is available to assist you with specific questions regarding customized spell work, corporate gifting, or wholesale orders.

ABOUT.NARRATIVE_P1: WitchLab was born out of a desire to bridge the gap between ancient botanical wisdom and high-end modern design. We believe that rituals are not primitive superstitions; they are deliberate psychological and energetic focus structures.
ABOUT.NARRATIVE_P2: By engaging the senses—the crackle of an herb-infused candle, the rich scent of cold-pressed oils, the tactile weight of an engraved talisman—we anchor our intentions in physical reality.

PILLARS.SOURCED_DESC: All of our wildcrafted herbs are harvested with permission, respecting local bio-networks. We reject commercial monoculture cultivation in favor of small, biodynamic partners.
PILLARS.LUNAR_DESC: We schedule our production schedules in alignment with celestial patterns. Cleansing items are poured during the waning moon; prosperity collections are finalized during the waxing moon.
PILLARS.ARTIST_DESC: Every bottle is individually layered, corked, and sealed by hand in our physical studio. Our talismans are hand-engraved, ensuring no two products are identical.

ABOUT.CTA_DESC: Browse our apothecary collections or consult our ritual guide to discover your own manifestational path.

BIRTH.TIME_UNKNOWN: I don't know my birth time
BIRTH.TIME_UNKNOWN_NOTE: That is a fine answer. The reading will leave out everything that depends on an exact time rather than guessing at it, and it will tell you what it left out.
BIRTH.PLACE_PLACEHOLDER: Start typing a city or town
BIRTH.PLACE_MANUAL_NOTE: The list covers cities and towns, not every village. If your birthplace isn't in it, enter the coordinates directly — a nearby town is fine for the planets, but the rising sign and houses are sensitive to longitude.
BIRTH.PRIVACY_NOTE: Your birth details go straight from this page to the calculation. They are never put in a web address, never written to a log, and never shown to anyone you share a reading with.

READING.TITLE: Your reading
READING.CAUTIONED_LEAD: The traditions consulted here warn about these for you. They are shown rather than hidden, with the warning attached.

READING.CALENDAR_UNRESOLVED: This calendar names a stone the catalogue cannot yet identify.

READING.SHARE_NOTE: A shared link shows the stones and the reasoning. It never shows your birth details.
READING.NO_RECOMMENDATIONS: Not enough of the chart could be read to rank anything. If you left the birth time out, adding it will usually change that.
READING.GONE_TITLE: This reading is no longer here
READING.GONE: Readings made without an account are kept for a while and then let go. Nothing was lost that cannot be made again — a new reading from the same birth details produces the same stones.
READING.DESIGN_TITLE: Craft a bracelet from these stones
READING.DESIGN_DESC: Choose which stones above to string and the size that fits your wrist.
READING.READY_HEADING: Your astrological stones have been selected
READING.READY_DESC: Stones recommended for your chart have been ranked. You can proceed directly to crafting your bracelet or explore each stone below.

CONFIDENCE.NOTE: This describes how firmly the tradition states the association — not how likely it is to be true.
